LobuleSize.description: Element sizes of the lobule mesh.

interior_um.description: Element size in the interior in um (default 20).

wall_um.description: Element size at the vein walls in um (default 5), must be > 0 and <= `interior_um`.

MapSpec.description: A raster map: one float value per pixel, placed in the scene's um coordinates.

id.description: Unique map id: an ASCII letter, then ASCII letters, digits and `_`.

no_value.description: Pixel value that marks "no data", if any.

origin_um.description:
Position `[x, y]` in um of the centre of pixel (row 0, col 0); rows run along y, columns
along x.

path.description:
Path of the raster file; relative paths resolve against the directory of the scene
file (`Scene::load` stores the absolute path).

um_per_px.description: Pixel size in um, must be > 0.

units.description: Units of the map values, free text (e.g. `1` for a dimensionless coordinate).

MeshSource.description: Where the mesh of the scene comes from.

oneOf.description: A gmsh `.msh` file; its physical groups are the tags.

path.description:
Path of the mesh file; relative paths resolve against the directory of the scene
file (`Scene::load` stores the absolute path).

oneOf.description: Tagged polygons (`polygons/1`), meshed by slidesim with the given size field.

path.description:
Path of the `polygons/1` file; relative paths resolve against the directory of the
scene file (`Scene::load` stores the absolute path).

size.description: Target element size over the domain.

oneOf.description: Parametric hexagonal lobules, generated and meshed by slidesim.

area_tag.description: Tag of the tissue area; no default.

centre.description: The central vein; no default for the tag.

tag.description: Edge tag of the vein wall.

corner.description: The portal veins at the corners; no default for the tag.

tag.description: Edge tag of the vein wall.

jitter.description: Largest displacement of a vein as a fraction of `lobule_radius_um`, `0 <= jitter <= 0.25`.

lobule_radius_um.description: Circumradius of the hexagonal lobule in um, must be > 0.

outer_tag.description: Tag of the outer boundary of the domain; no default.

rings.description: Rings of neighbouring lobules around the central one (0: a single lobule), at most 4.

zonation.description: The zonation raster generated over the domain; no default for the map id.

SizeField.description:
Element size as a function of the distance to the nearest edge of the `walls` tags: `min_um`
up to `dist_min_um`, linear up to `max_um` at `dist_max_um`, `max_um` beyond. Without walls
the size is `max_um` everywhere.

dist_max_um.description: Distance in um from which the size is `max_um`.

dist_min_um.description: Distance in um up to which the size is `min_um`, must be >= 0 and < `dist_max_um`.

max_um.description: Element size far from the walls in um.

min_um.description: Element size near the walls in um, must be > 0 and <= `max_um`.

walls.description: Edge tags the distance is measured from.

length.description: Length unit of the mesh coordinates; only `um` (micrometre) is supported.

ZonationSpec.description: The zonation map generated for the lobules.

map.description:
Map id a study refers to: an ASCII letter, then ASCII letters, digits and `_`; must not
be the id of an entry of `maps`.

um_per_px.description: Pixel size in um (default 2), must be > 0.

description: `scene/1`: the geometry description written by slideviz.

dimension.description: Spatial dimension of the mesh (2 or 3).

maps.description: Raster maps over the tissue (e.g. a zonation coordinate); studies refer to them by id.
